zh: 最短蓄力时的速度倍率（旧 ID minimum_seconds）

en: Speed multiplier at full overcharge (old id maximum_seconds)
zh: 完全过载时的速度倍率（旧 ID maximum_seconds）

en: releasing earlier cancels the shot; these multipliers apply at the minimum time and rise to 1.0 at full charge
zh: 提前松开会取消射击；这些倍率在最短时间生效，并在满蓄力时升至 1.0
此时所有射击倍率均为 1.0

en: only in fire mode 6 (Railgun Unsafe, the Epoch always); multipliers go from 1.0 to these values
zh: 仅在射击模式 6 下（磁轨炮“不安全”模式，Epoch 始终如此）；倍率从 1.0 变为这些值

zh: 为旧模组保留；它们写入的是上方的速度倍率

en: While the trigger is held the charge grows. A release at or after the minimum time fires; each multiplier goes linearly from its minimum value to 1.0 at full charge, then to its overcharge value at the overcharge time.
zh: 按住扳机时蓄力持续增长。在最短时间或之后松开即开火；每个倍率从其最小值线性变化到满蓄力时的 1.0，再在过载时间变为其过载值。

en: This project is bound to SDK {0}, which publishes no charge ranges or the newer charge fields. Rebind it to HD2Runtime 0.30 to edit them.
zh: 此项目绑定的是 SDK {0}，它不发布蓄力范围，也不包含较新的蓄力字段。请重新绑定到 HD2Runtime 0.30 以编辑它们。
comment: {0}: the bound SDK version
{0}: minimum; {1}: maximum (Runtime's published range)

en: The full charge time ({0} s) is not above the minimum ({1} s). Runtime applies it and logs CHARGE ORDER once: outside fire mode 6 a release never reaches the minimum and fires nothing unless automatic fire at full charge is on. Lower the minimum charge time too to keep them ordered.
zh: 满蓄力时间（{0} 秒）不大于最短时间（{1} 秒）。Runtime 仍会应用，并记录一次 CHARGE ORDER：在射击模式 6 之外，松开时永远达不到最短时间，除非开启满蓄力自动开火，否则不会射击。请同时降低最短蓄力时间以保持顺序。
comment: {0}: full charge time in seconds; {1}: minimum charge time in seconds

en: The overcharge time ({0} s) is not above the full charge time ({1} s). Runtime applies it and logs CHARGE ORDER once: in fire mode 6 the overcharge is reached at {0} s and the shot multipliers jump to their overcharge values (with explode at the overcharge time, the weapon fires and is destroyed).
zh: 过载时间（{0} 秒）不大于满蓄力时间（{1} 秒）。Runtime 仍会应用，并记录一次 CHARGE ORDER：在射击模式 6 下，{0} 秒时即达到过载，射击倍率直接跳到过载值（若开启达到过载时间时爆炸，武器会开火并被摧毁）。
comment: {0}: overcharge time in seconds; {1}: full charge time in seconds

en: Saved on SDK {0}, which labelled this field a "Charge level" multiplier. It has always been this charge time in seconds: the value written is unchanged.
zh: 此修改保存于 SDK {0}，当时该字段被标为“Charge level”倍率。它一直就是以秒为单位的这个蓄力时间：写入的值没有变化。
comment: {0}: SDK version the edit was saved on

en: Hazard: when it triggers, the weapon is destroyed in the wielder's hands and its overcharge explosion spawns there.
zh: 危险：触发时，武器会在持有者手中被摧毁，并在该处生成过载爆炸。

en: HD2Runtime 0.30 corrects this id: it writes the projectile speed multiplier, not a time (arc and beam weapons never read it). Rebind to SDK 0.30 for the corrected fields.
zh: HD2Runtime 0.30 更正了此 ID：它写入的是弹体速度倍率，而非时间（电弧和光束武器从不读取它）。请重新绑定到 SDK 0.30 以使用更正后的字段。

en: This edit uses a deprecated id. It writes {0}: move it to that field, or move the value to the charge time you meant.
zh: 此修改使用了已弃用的 ID。它写入的是 {0}：请将其移到该字段，或将数值移到你原本想设置的蓄力时间。
comment: {0}: the field the deprecated id writes

en: This edit uses a deprecated id that this weapon never reads: it has no effect. Move the value to the charge time you meant, or remove it.
zh: 此修改使用了该武器从不读取的已弃用 ID：它没有任何效果。请将数值移到你原本想设置的蓄力时间，或将其移除。

en: This edit uses an id published as a charge time; HD2Runtime 0.30 shows it writes a speed multiplier. If you meant a charge time, move the value to it.
zh: 此修改使用的 ID 曾被发布为蓄力时间；HD2Runtime 0.30 表明它写入的是速度倍率。如果你想设置的是蓄力时间，请将数值移过去。

comment: {0}: field name
{0}: charge time field name

zh: 该武器从不读取此字段：写入没有任何效果。

{0}: package dependency such as support_weapon/PLAS-45 Epoch

comment: {0}: the new value

zh: 此武器带有射速选择器：此字段只写入其默认（中间）射速，其他模式保持不变。请在“射速与功能”中编辑所有模式。

zh: 尽管此武器的目录未列出其他使用者，该行也被 {0} 使用：在此修改也会改变它，Runtime 会在修改注册时记录这一点。其他模组修改它会产生冲突。

comment: {0}, {1}: Runtime log phrases, kept in English
